name: Total Teacher FTE
formula_summary: Total certified instructional teacher full-time equivalents

name: Classroom Teacher FTE
formula_summary: General and subject-matter classroom teacher FTE excluding specialists

name: Paraprofessional FTE
formula_summary: Instructional aides and paraprofessional full-time equivalents
target_population: Instructional support aides in public schools

name: Section Enrollment
formula_summary: Rostered student headcount in a distinct course section
target_population: Secondary students enrolled in credit-bearing courses

name: Student-Weighted Class Size
formula_summary: Sum of squared section enrollments / Sum of section enrollments (or teacher survey mean)

name: Chronic Absenteeism Rate
formula_summary: Students missing >= 10% of enrolled school days / Total enrolled students
target_population: Public K-12 students enrolled for >= 90 days

name: IDEA Special Education Enrollment
formula_summary: Students with Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) under IDEA Part B
target_population: Public school students receiving special education services

name: Section 504 Accommodation Enrollment
formula_summary: Students receiving accommodations under Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act
